QuestInfo.name: A Gift from Intaglio
QuestInfo.0: #rProfession Grand Opening Quest\n#k(Available until Jan 31st, 2011)#k\nTo celebrate reaching Lv #r4#k in Accessory Crafting, #bIntaglio#k has a gift for you.
QuestInfo.1: Your hard work is being recognized. Congratulations!
QuestInfo.2: Master #bIntaglio#k will have another gift for you once you reach Lv. #r10#k Accessory Crafting. Keep up the good work!

0.0: #h0#, my darling, darling student! You're a Lv. 4 Jeweler! When did that happen? Oh, that doesn't matter. I've had something set aside for just this occasion!

yes.0: Oh, this is so exciiiting! Now, where was it? Oh, give me a second... Talk to me a little later.

no.0: You don't want it? But why not? I know you don't mean that. I'll hold it for you until #rJanuary 31, 2011#k, just in case you change your mind.

1.0: Now that you've had a taste of Accessory Crafting, you should try making something really special. This is a difficult Recipe, but it's all yours now! Oh, I can't wait until you're Lv. #r10#k Jeweler, just like me!
